caption: A round tower with a tall upright body, a curved crown and a lower front entrance. From the base up to the crown the walls continue unbroken; the lower front entrance opens inside. Curved substantial surfaces carry their attached functional parts without interruption. Overall width is 1.00 times depth; height is 2.20 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous gray, red color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
